answer: A sybil registry forces each AI agent to lock a deposit of tokenized onyx, copper, and yarrow and bind it to a hardware TPM attestation key. The agent must submit a fresh TPM quote hourly; if two identities ever submit quotes from the same TPM, the contract slashes that deposit. An attacker must buy one TPM and lock one onyx-copper-yarrow deposit per fake identity, and reusing a TPM costs the deposit without yielding another identity.
